stem: During a community child health visit, a parent asks which vaccine is specifically funded for Aboriginal children from 6 months of age; which is the best answer?
explanation: Influenza is the correct answer. It is specifically noted as being funded for Aboriginal children from 6 months of age.

citations.source: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
citations.title: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Health

optionExplanations.A: Incorrect because BCG is listed as an immunisation difference, but the vaccine specifically funded from 6 months is influenza.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because Hepatitis A is listed as an immunisation difference, but the vaccine specifically funded from 6 months is influenza.
optionExplanations.C: Correct because influenza is specifically noted as being funded for Aboriginal children from 6 months of age.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because Meningococcal B is listed as an immunisation difference, but the vaccine specifically funded from 6 months is influenza.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because pneumococcal is listed as an immunisation difference, but the vaccine specifically funded from 6 months is influenza.
